modules.module_title: Obtain information and inspect condition of equipment

pcs.pc_description: obtain details of cargo to be loaded/ unloaded, deck and yard layout and any other specific instruction from the yard supervisor
engage with the ship and yard supervisor and the rigging staff, and finalise the type of crane to use and techniques for lifting
finalise the path for movement of the cargo in coordination with lifting supervisor, yard supervisor and rigging staff
wear the required PPEs and carry the communication device
check the crane/ MHEs controls for fitness of operation including breaking tests, boom operation, spreader movement
test drive the trolley and check that all hydraulic systems to operate hoisting system, flippers, and emergency controls etc. before operation
escalate any issues to the supervisor
check for clear visibility from the control unit platform to vessel, yard and the spreaders
check for weather condition and factor those in while operations
follow the SOP during the cargo handling process
follow the hand signals and Very High Frequency (VHF) communications from the signalman to move the crane and cargo
place cargo/ container at the assigned location in coordination with the instruction of the signalman to ensure zero damage
verify that the containers are properly locked before moving, based on system input and rigger confirmation
monitor the container and spreader movement during operations, to ensure safe limits
take necessary precautions while handling dangerous and hazardous goods
fill the post operation checklist on completion of activity
report on delays, damages, accidents and other incidents to the supervisor and prepare necessary documentation for insurance claims if any
report on the condition of the crane/ MHE and any maintenance activity or replacement that may be required to the supervisor

pcs.pc_description: • perform basic maintenance checks such as: • a. check for accidental damages on the body of the MHE • b. check that the spreader, quay, control unit, etc. are operating as per the specified norms • c. check for any irregular noise during operation and troubleshoot • d. check that all controls and communication systems are functional • e. check for damage in tyres, rails, parking brake, main horn, reverse horn, warning lamp, etc.
check fluid levels of engine, transmission, differential, hydraulic, radiator coolant and brake oil and top up any fluids as required
identify any requirement for painting, greasing, welding, part replacement, etc. to the supervisor
perform preventive maintenance for faults like fractures, corrosion, missing paint, etc. on the body of the crane/ MHE as per schedule in accordance to checklist
test the crane/ MHE for all controls as per the checklist to see that it is fully functional and safe for use
update maintenance card and report
report to supervisors and request technical support in case of any abnormalities in operation, damage, repair requirement, etc.
lookout for basic aberrations such as irregular noise, blockages, error in operations, and identify the source of issue
perform basic first-line repairs like greasing, painting, oiling, removing of stuck objects, changing of fuse, making severed electrical connections, etc. and check if the problem is resolved
check the parts to assess damage, repair requirements, electrical faults, faulty control systems, etc.
escalate the problems to supervisor and request technical support if required
